votes.motion: Tina Griffis moved to APPROVE the Planning Commissioner meeting minutes from April 6, 2022

Ulises Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council on the proposed Ordinance Text Amendments to Bluffdale City Code Sections 3.80 (Home Occupations), 6.20 (Truck Routes), 11.20 and 11.160 (Land Use Ordinance) to update the standards related to truck routes, storage use, and the parking of large commercial vehicles in certain residential zones. (Application 2022-07)

Ulises Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for just the proposed Ordinance Text Amendments to Bluffdale City Code 11.11.070 (Mixed-Use Zone) to allow a "Property Management Firm Sales/Leasing Office" in a residential area in the Mixed- Use ("MU") Zoning District, Banner Hill, LLC Applicants (Application 2022- 10)
